Meta.title: Miguel Barra — Full Stack Developer
Meta.description: Portfolio of Miguel Barra, Full Stack Developer in Santiago, Chile. Builds complete products with React, Next.js and TypeScript and ships them to production.

Hero.title: I build full-stack products and ship them to production.
Hero.subtitle: Over 2 years shipping software for public- and private-sector clients in Chile, with React, Next.js and TypeScript and a firm grip on the whole stack.

About.photoAlt: Portrait of Miguel Barra, Full Stack Developer
About.body: I'm a Full Stack Developer with over 2 years shipping software for the public and private sectors: a SaaS to digitise municipal paperwork, the overhaul of a Codelco health insurer's member portal, and my own tools for the Chilean market. I work with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and move comfortably across the whole stack: database, APIs, authentication and infrastructure.
About.headingRich: I bring frontend, backend and infrastructure together <muted>to ship complete products that work end to end.</muted>

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.desc: Fast, accessible and maintainable interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

backend.title: Backend & APIs
backend.desc: Solid business logic and REST APIs with Node.js, NestJS, ASP.NET and Python/Flask.

data.title: Data & Cloud
data.desc: Databases, containers and deployment: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Docker, Azure, GCP and Vercel, with CI/CD on GitHub Actions.

Cases.heading: Case studies
Cases.subtitle: Not just what I build, but how I build it and how I test it.
